fact: On 11 September 2026 the Abidjan prosecutor placed opposition PPA-CI vice-president Justin Katinan Koné in detention after a complaint by the ruling party, having first summoned him for defamation, insults and false news over his public critique of illegal gold mining policy.
title: Côte d'Ivoire : le PPA-CI dénonce un « terrorisme judiciaire » après l'incarcération de Katinan Koné
